claim_boundary: validation-only evidence for upstream issues/PRs; not external adoption or prospective I2

replay.command_semantics: use-first-env-state; target control pd_ee_delta_pose; obs state; save trajectory; 10 envs; physx_cpu
replay.rule: Each variant MUST replay/convert the same raw trajectory independently. Reusing one preconverted state/action H5 across variants invalidates the factorial because #1495 acts in conversion.py.

official_training.note: Start with seed 1 across all four cells. Only expand to seeds 2/3 after the complete four-cell seed-1 run succeeds.

fail_closed_gates: all four code worktrees exactly match frozen SHAs
each variant independently regenerates the converted dataset from the same raw demonstration
converted companion JSON exists and episode counts match across all four variants
official profile requires at least 100 converted episodes in every variant
same training hyperparameters and seed within each four-cell block
do not interpret smoke/pilot runs as final policy-performance evidence
primary_metrics: conversion/replay episode count and failure rate

validation_surface.freeze_rule: Do not modify experiment semantics after this head. Any required harness bugfix must be recorded as a protocol revision and rerun all four cells.

analysis_freeze.seed1: Run all four cells before inspecting or changing the official configuration.
analysis_freeze.expansion: Only after a valid complete seed-1 four-cell block may seeds 2 and 3 be run.
